bindings.name: bb_frame_manager_slot
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x55404c8 (RW data): frame manager singleton pointer. Loaded by the main step (eboot+0x201a1cb mov rbx,[r13] before calling eboot+0x2035ac0) and read the same way by Lance McDonald's 1.09 patch at the matching 1.09 global (0x55404f8, data shifted by +0x30).

sites.name: pacer_mode03_frame_time
sites.evidence: eboot+0x2035baa in the frame pacer eboot+0x2035ac0 (r12 = frame manager): mov dword [r12+0x18], 0x3d088889 (1/30) for pacing modes 0 and 3. Single instruction; mode 0 jumps to its start.

sites.name: pacer_mode03_window
sites.evidence: eboot+0x2035bb3: movabs rcx, 0x1e00000001; eboot+0x2035be1 stores rcx to [r12+0x268]. Not a branch target.

sites.name: pacer_mode14_frame_time
sites.evidence: eboot+0x2035bce: mov dword [r12+0x18], 1/30 for pacing modes 1 and 4 (mode 4 is the one observed live). Mode 1 jumps to its start; the following instruction is a separate branch target and stays outside this site.

sites.name: pacer_mode124_window
sites.evidence: eboot+0x2035bd7: movabs rcx, 0x1e00000000, shared by modes 1/4 and mode 2 (which jumps here after setting 1/60). Lance McDonald's 1.09 patch rewrites the same shared instruction.

sites.name: main_step_delta
sites.evidence: eboot+0x201a1e6 in the main step eboot+0x201a0d0, after call eboot+0x2035ac0: mov dword [rbp-0x38], 1/30; block at rbp-0x40 is passed to eboot+0x2052690. Lance McDonald's 1.09 patch feeds the frame manager's +0x264 here.

sites.name: update_17f9b40_delta
sites.evidence: eboot+0x17f9ce1 in eboot+0x17f9b40: mov dword [rbp-0x48], 1/30 into a local block, before call [vtable+0x48]. Corresponding 1.09 site is fed from the frame manager's +0x264 by Lance McDonald's patch.

sites.name: ai_frames_to_seconds
sites.evidence: eboot+0x1dbc4f8 in SprjWorldAiManager frame bookkeeping: vmulss xmm0, xmm0, [rip+0x2b6cec8] where eboot+0x49293c8 holds 1/30, converting the frame count at [r13+0x250] to seconds. Without this site in-game audio skipped at 60 FPS (desktop test, XML v3 vs v4a).
